products.name: DISA STIG Compliance for Windows 10 & 11 in Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Implement and continuously manage DISA STIG compliance for Windows 10 and 11 in Microsoft Intune — build the hardened baseline by severity as Intune policy, prove compliance, and update it each time a new STIG releases. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Harden Windows 10 & 11 to the DISA STIG in Intune — and keep it compliant as new STIGs release

Defense and federal environments must meet the DISA STIG for Windows, and auditors expect proof. Applying hundreds of STIG rules by hand — and re-checking them every quarter when DISA publishes a new benchmark — is brutal, and manual GPO-era approaches don't follow cloud-managed devices. This solution delivers a repeatable way to implement and continuously manage DISA STIG compliance for Windows 10 and 11 in Microsoft Intune: build the hardened baseline as Intune policy, prove compliance, and run a documented update process each time a new STIG release drops.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what the DISA STIG is, CAT I/II/III severities, how STIG rules map to Intune (settings catalog and imported ADMX) vs. the Microsoft security baselines, the compliance/reporting model, and the STIG-release maintenance lifecycle.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, supported Windows 10/11, device groups, the official DISA STIG / STIG Viewer / SCAP content, documented exceptions/POA&M process) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide (net-new) — exact, ordered steps: stage the STIG, build the configuration in Intune by severity, handle documented exceptions (POA&M), assign to a pilot, validate compliance, then expand fleet-wide.
  • Maintenance & Update Guide — a repeatable process for each new STIG release: obtain the new version, diff it against your live baseline, assess and approve changes, update the Intune policies in a controlled change, re-validate, and record the STIG version you are on.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — STIG-readiness discovery, per-device STIG-compliance validation, a fleet STIG posture and drift report, safe remediation of drifted settings, and a STIG-version comparison helper that diffs a new STIG export against your current baseline.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every Windows 10/11 device hardened to the DISA STIG and provably compliant — with a documented update lifecycle that keeps the baseline current as DISA revises it and exceptions tracked as POA&M — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, maintenance & updates, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • STIG-Compare-StigVersion.ps1 — diff a NEW DISA STIG export against the current live baseline
    • STIG-Discovery.ps1 — tenant/device DISA STIG readiness for Windows 10/11
    • STIG-Remediation.ps1 — safely reapply a drifted DISA STIG baseline by forcing policy re-apply
    • STIG-Report.ps1 — fleet DISA STIG posture + drift via Microsoft Graph (Intune device config states)
    • STIG-Validation.ps1 — per-device DISA STIG compliance check against the expected baseline

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
